## Limitations

## PR Reviewer technical gate
- Verdict: Pending / PASS / CHANGES_REQUESTED / WAITING
- Reviewed head SHA / base SHA:
- Mergeability: clean / conflicting / unknown (source and observation time)
- Checks and evidence limits:
- Findings and Engineer follow-up:

Technical approval is separate from owner acceptance. New commits/base changes require re-review. With a shared author/reviewer identity, record the agent verdict as a comment; it is not a formal GitHub approval.

## Owner review gate
- [ ] Owner acceptance recorded for this revision

Do not merge, close the story, or begin the next engineering story until the owner accepts and this PR is merged. This checkbox is a reminder, not a substitute for owner-authored acceptance.
